### Changed

- Updated the OpenCode plugin SDK to 2.2.7.
- Updated all direct development dependencies to their latest stable versions, including TypeScript 7, Vite 8, Vitest 5 and jsdom 31.
- Refreshed transitive dependencies and removed the unused glob override.
- Updated source development requirements and CI to Node.js 22.22.2 and 24.15.0 on Windows and Ubuntu.
- Updated the pinned installation examples to 0.1.2.

### Notes

- Existing response-time behavior and package exports are unchanged; Desktop compatibility was previously verified on OpenCode 2.2.1.
- npm audit reports 21 moderate findings in the OpenCode SDK's transitive dependency tree with no compatible fix currently available.
- The OpenCode GUI build plugin emits an inlineDynamicImports deprecation warning under Vite 8; the build succeeds.

## OpenCode Agent Response Time v0.1.1

Hover the duration at the bottom of an agent response, or any paragraph, heading, list item, quote or code block in the response text, to see the exact completion time.

### Added

- Response text hover: the timestamp appears near the pointer
- Paragraphs, headings, list items, block quotes, code blocks and tables are supported
- Links, buttons, text selection and pointer presses suppress the body tooltip

### Install

```jsonc
"plugins": [
  "@devdengchao/opencode-plugin-show-agent-response-time@0.1.1"
]
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@devdengchao/opencode-plugin-show-agent-response-time

## OpenCode Agent Response Time v0.1.0

Hover the duration at the bottom of an agent response in OpenCode Desktop to see the exact completion time of that turn.

### Highlights

- Hover tooltip on completed agent response durations
- Exact turn completion timestamp read from the current session's synced messages
- Native compact tooltip styling, light/dark themes and locale-aware formatting
- npm installation, preview image and CI workflow

### Install

```jsonc
"plugins": [
  "@devdengchao/opencode-plugin-show-agent-response-time@0.1.0"
]
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@devdengchao/opencode-plugin-show-agent-response-time
